_note: Employers Tier 1 (enrich/rules.py) treats as 'her target companies' when it appears in an event's title or host names. SPEC.md §2: target_proximity is the density of people CURRENTLY INSIDE target companies. This is a declared, editable list, not a learned one — add or remove names freely; it only changes which events get target_proximity filled by rule. Matching is case-sensitive and word-bounded, so ambiguous common words (Apple, Meta, Block) are deliberately NOT listed.
